reviews.reason: The refutation uses the CH theorem only for its unchanged conclusion that a normal nonmetrizable Moore space exists. That theorem supplies the repaired construction's exact finite case, kappa=omega and kappa_n=n, including direct ladder separation; Fleissner's printed clause (4) requires only finite approximation sets in this case and his final argument uses infinite Ramsey. The local finite-bound repair therefore restores the supplier proof without changing Fact F3 or the refutation's proof-composition argument.

Facts F1 and F2 supply exactly the repaired construction's hypotheses: an infinite kappa, an increasing cofinal cardinal sequence with the power bounds, the stationary set, and the ladder-separation functions. For kappa>omega the repaired proof passes to an infinite-cardinal tail; for kappa=omega it uses the finite approximation bound and Ramsey exception printed by Fleissner. No hypothesis or conclusion consumed in step 3.1 changed, so the item carrier needs no impact repair.

The contrapositive uses the repaired HYP theorem only at step 3.1 to obtain a normal nonmetrizable Moore space from the HYP parameters supplied by Fact F1. Fleissner's paper states both that HYP yields this space and that failure of the relevant inner-model alternative supplies HYP; the finite-cardinal enumeration correction changes neither interface. The resulting contradiction with NMSC and hence the inner-model conclusion remain unchanged.

The item carrier was unchanged during this impact wave and already labels its conclusion external and metatheoretic, explicitly denying a proof in an unspecified arithmetic base. Fleissner's Figure 1 describes the consistency-strength arrows as model constructions, while Freiburg Lemma 3.5.12 gives the corresponding external Con transfer from a provable nonempty-class model. Only the owning-page summary's stale word 'formal' was changed to 'metatheoretic'; this is a metadata-only page repair, not an item-carrier repair.

Fact F1 and proof step 1.1 import only the lower supplier's unchanged external consistency implication; they do not call it an arithmetic-base theorem or require a uniform proof-code reduction. Fact F3 expressly separates the internal inner-model theorem from both consistency implications, and the upper-bound branch is independent of the renamed lower supplier. The corrected metatheoretic label therefore leaves the sandwich statement and proof accurate without an item edit.
